Byte Symphony

A collection of tools, experiments, and data-driven projects that explore the intersection of creative technology and human insights.

Where AI meets audio intelligence. These projects represent Taiwo Heard's R&D side—tools built to solve real problems, experiments that push technical boundaries, and data-driven explorations that reveal hidden patterns. From YouTube analytics to Bayesian statistics education, each project demonstrates what happens when you combine a problem-solving mindset with creative curiosity.

Featured Project

AI Analytics

DREAMY

Python • LangChain • Supabase • YouTube Data API v3

Specialized analytics intelligence platform designed for YouTube creators. Here's the real magic: DREAMY moves beyond static dashboards to provide a personable, interactive consultant that interprets complex metrics in plain English.

Ask natural questions like "Why did my views drop last month?" or "Which videos should I promote?" and get contextual answers grounded in your actual channel data. Built with custom Hybrid RAG architecture (TF-IDF + BM25) for semantic search that understands creator intent.

Status: Live Demo Available

Development & Data Tools

Audio Tech

Sweetspot

Python • PyQt5 • NumPy

Real-time microphone distance trainer using audio level analysis and visual color feedback. Helps podcasters and vocalists build muscle memory for optimal mic technique.

Teaching Tool

BayesQuest

JavaScript • Educational Design

Interactive teaching tool designed to demystify Bayesian statistics through gamified exploration. Historical intuition replaces abstract formulas, making probability theory accessible to students and non-mathematicians.

Cognate Analysis

A deep dive into linguistic overlaps between English and Spanish. Analyzes cognates to uncover patterns in language evolution and accelerate exploration through data visualization.
